Figure 4. One case through the method: 의성·안동 at 18:00 KST on 25 March 2025. Inputs (a); the forecast model's learned spread kernels and next-hour chance of
burning (b); heat, shown on the US Fish Creek fire because no Korean fuel maps exist (c). The road plan uses the detected fire, not (b)–(c): the known fire plus a
calibrated 10 km margin (d) sets when each road is blocked, and a backward pass gives 원당리 a leave-by time of 18:15 and a route that an independent checker
accepted (e–f). At this hour the gate withheld the answer: the fire was unlike every calibration fire.
